text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in opening paragraph","quality":"clear position","description":"The essay states its stance directly and consistently, so the reader immediately knows what it is arguing."},{"evidence":"body paragraph on fault, cost, and safety","quality":"argument development","description":"It develops reasons for its position with multiple supporting points instead of mainly restating the idea."},{"evidence":"“If the technology fails... who is at fault?” and “people wonder if the initial cost...”","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges objections and responds to them rather than ignoring the other side."},{"evidence":"mentions fuel savings, wrecks, insurance, stress, entertainment, and manual takeover","quality":"supporting evidence","description":"It uses a wider range of relevant article details to back up the argument."},{"evidence":"transitions like “However,” “Additionally,” and “Lastly”","quality":"organization","description":"Its ideas are arranged in a more controlled sequence that helps the argument move logically from point to point."},{"evidence":"opening hook and concluding restatement","quality":"intro conclusion","description":"It has a more complete argumentative frame with an engaging introduction and a clear wrap-up."}]}
